run_grpc_interop_test_client: run the gRPC interoperability test client against a server with --server_port and --test_case args
test_fork_function: test the gRPC fork client by running test_fork to execute test cases against a server
run_all_test_cases: run all gRPC test cases by passing --test_case all to the fork client CLI
parse_bool_argument: parse a boolean CLI argument that accepts only true or false string values
lookup_test_case_by_name: lookup a TestCase enum member by its string value using _test_case_from_arg
